close_reason: Applied Option A: replaced 'is a RevocationChecker' / 'A RevocationChecker that ...' with 'Will implement RevocationChecker once fetching is wired up' on HttpCrlFetcher, HttpOcspFetcher, and the crate-level Design section. No type-system claim now mismatches reality. Docs build with -D warnings.
description:
pkix-revocation-http/src/lib.rs:81-86:
  /// A [`pkix_revocation::RevocationChecker`] that fetches CRLs on demand.
  ...
  pub struct HttpCrlFetcher<F> { ... }

The doc claim 'is a RevocationChecker' is false in the type system: HttpCrlFetcher<F> does NOT implement RevocationChecker — there is no `impl RevocationChecker for HttpCrlFetcher` block. Same for HttpOcspFetcher (line 111).

This is technically a stub crate at v0.0.0, and the # Limitations section says 'Not yet implemented (PKIX-58m)'. So it is not production-misleading. But the type-system claim and the prose claim disagree.

Fix options:

A. (preferred) Replace the type-system claim with one that matches reality:
   /// Will implement [`pkix_revocation::RevocationChecker`] once fetching is wired up.

B. Add a stub impl that returns Err(...) from every method, similar to how pkix-composite has a stub impl SignatureVerifier that returns SignatureError::new() (lib.rs:74-86). This is more consistent with the rest of the workspace.

Severity: P3 / opinion — fact-check on stub-crate documentation.

Pass-1 attribution: not flagged. Pass 1 bumped these to v0.0.0 (PKIX-gdvf) but didn't reconcile the doc/type-system gap.
title: P3: pkix-revocation-http stubs claim 'is a RevocationChecker' in docs but do not impl the trait
